title: Requesting a quote by a deadline

lines.speaker: Buyer
lines.text: Hi Lena, could you send me a quote for 500 units by Friday?

lines.speaker: Supplier
lines.text: Of course. Do you need delivery included?

lines.speaker: Buyer
lines.text: Yes, please include delivery to our Shanghai warehouse.

lines.speaker: Supplier
lines.text: No problem. I'll send it over by Thursday afternoon.

drills.instruction: Replace the document and the deadline.
drills.model: Could you send me the quote by Friday?

answers: Could you send me the contract by Monday?
items.translation: 能在周一前把合同发给我吗？

items.cue: the invoice / the end of the day
answers: Could you send me the invoice by the end of the day?
items.translation: 能在今天下班前把发票发给我吗？

items.cue: the updated price list / noon tomorrow
answers: Could you send me the updated price list by noon tomorrow?
items.translation: 能在明天中午前把最新价目表发给我吗？

drills.modelTranslation: 能在周五前把报价发给我吗？
